product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet XO Gold Metalic Print Wall Art in White Wood Frame, 21" x 15"
product.description: The alphabet symbols for hugs and kisses will set the stage for your apartment to be a welcoming place. The metallic gold foil letters are printed on a white background for a touch of glam. The piece is attractively housed in a white wood frame. A contemporary, artsy take on recognizable symbols of love Modern gold foil printed on wood for a simple, contemporary touch 21" x 15" Ready to hang with hardware included. Made to order
